posts.name: Agent Bon
posts.cooked:
Parse found Tachyon deep in thought, reading a message:

“I, Baron Blade, am about prepared to reveal a new, ingenious, all-powerful form.  Ha ha ha!  Observe the Overblade Elite Neo Cuts 9!”

Tachyon:  I think there’s a secret message, but I can’t find it.

Parse:  Maybe it would be easier if we rearranged it?

[code]IBARONBLAD
EAMABOUTPR
EPAREDTORE
VEALANEWIN
GENIOUSALL
POWERFULFO
RMHAHAHAOB
SERVETHEOV
ERBLADEELI
TENEOCUTS9[/code]

Tachyon:  How is that easier?

Parse:  You don’t see it?  Maybe you’re overthinking it.  It’s all about the number nine.
